answer: Resist Sybils with a diversity-gated attestation graph. A new identity starts with zero trust and may only open a small vault of low-value deals. To graduate it must collect attestations from established agents in several unconnected trust clusters, like gathering one pearl from each of several distant reefs, not a string from one bed. Faking a fleet means doing useful work for many strangers over weeks, while graph analysis flags cliques of fresh identities vouching for each other and quarantines the whole onyx-black cluster before it can cash out.
